sequence_based_measurement.abstract_quote: We describe Cleavage Under Targets and Release Using Nuclease (CUT&RUN), a chromatin profiling strategy in which antibody-targeted controlled cleavage by micrococcal nuclease releases specific protein-DNA complexes into the supernatant for paired-end DNA sequencing.
sequence_based_measurement.rationale: Targeted physical cleavage and release are explicitly connected to DNA sequencing. The abstract does not supply complete library-preparation conditions.

assay_workflow_contribution.abstract_quote: Unlike Chromatin Immunoprecipitation (ChIP), which fragments and solubilizes total chromatin, CUT&RUN is performed in situ, allowing for both quantitative high-resolution chromatin mapping and probing of the local chromatin environment.
assay_workflow_contribution.rationale: The in situ targeted-cleavage strategy constitutes an assay architecture contribution. Complete implementation conditions are not specified.

experimental_demonstration.abstract_quote: When applied to yeast and human nuclei, CUT&RUN yielded precise transcription factor profiles while avoiding crosslinking and solubilization issues.
experimental_demonstration.rationale: Reported transcription-factor profiles establish experimental execution in yeast and human nuclei. Numerical reproducibility estimates are not provided.

papers.rationale: Introduces and experimentally demonstrates a physical chromatin-profiling assay with a sequencing readout.

sequence_based_measurement.abstract_quote: Here we developed simultaneous high-throughput ATAC and RNA expression with sequencing (SHARE-seq), a highly scalable approach for measurement of chromatin accessibility and gene expression in the same single cell, applicable to different tissues.
sequence_based_measurement.rationale: Explicitly describes sequencing-based measurement of accessibility and RNA in the same cell. The physical processing and library-preparation steps are not detailed.

assay_workflow_contribution.abstract_quote: Here we developed simultaneous high-throughput ATAC and RNA expression with sequencing (SHARE-seq), a highly scalable approach for measurement of chromatin accessibility and gene expression in the same single cell, applicable to different tissues.
assay_workflow_contribution.rationale: Development of joint same-cell accessibility and expression measurement establishes an assay-level contribution. The abstract does not explain how the modalities are linked experimentally.

experimental_demonstration.abstract_quote: Using 34,774 joint profiles from mouse skin, we develop a computational strategy to identify cis-regulatory interactions and define domains of regulatory chromatin (DORCs) that significantly overlap with super-enhancers.
experimental_demonstration.rationale: The reported joint mouse-skin profiles provide empirical output of the introduced assay. This passage does not establish performance across all other tissues.

papers.rationale: Introduces SHARE-seq and reports experimental joint profiles; downstream computational and biological contributions accompany the assay contribution.

sequence_based_measurement.abstract_quote: We also observe higher library diversity generated by Tn5-059 when compared to Nextera v2 for human exomes, which leads to less sequencing and lower cost per genome.
sequence_based_measurement.rationale: Reports generated human-exome sequencing libraries and their comparative diversity, establishing physical sequence-based evaluation. Complete preparation conditions are absent.

assay_workflow_contribution.abstract_quote: We demonstrate Tn5-059 reduces AT dropout and increases uniformity of genome coverage in both bacterial genomes and human genome. We also observe higher library diversity generated by Tn5-059 when compared to Nextera v2 for human exomes, which leads to less sequencing and lower cost per genome.
assay_workflow_contribution.rationale: Demonstrated gains in coverage uniformity and library diversity establish an improvement to sequencing library preparation. The abstract does not establish the suggested chromatin-profiling applications.

experimental_demonstration.abstract_quote: In addition, when used for human exomes, Tn5-059 delivers consistent library insert size over a range of input DNA, allowing up to a tenfold variance from the 50 ng input recommendation.
experimental_demonstration.rationale: Reports experimentally assessed library insert sizes across DNA inputs. Replicate counts and statistical uncertainty are not supplied.

papers.rationale: The engineered enzyme is connected to experimentally demonstrated library-preparation improvements, satisfying the assay criterion beyond reagent discovery alone.

sequence_based_measurement.abstract_quote: We developed chromVAR (http://www.github.com/GreenleafLab/chromVAR), an R package for analyzing sparse chromatin-accessibility data by estimating gain or loss of accessibility within peaks sharing the same motif or annotation while controlling for technical biases.
sequence_based_measurement.rationale: The described contribution analyzes chromatin-accessibility data computationally. The abstract does not report performing a physical sequencing-measurement workflow.

assay_workflow_contribution.abstract_quote: We developed chromVAR (http://www.github.com/GreenleafLab/chromVAR), an R package for analyzing sparse chromatin-accessibility data by estimating gain or loss of accessibility within peaks sharing the same motif or annotation while controlling for technical biases.
assay_workflow_contribution.rationale: Introduces an analytical package and computational bias control. No experimental assay architecture or physical workflow/library-preparation improvement is described.

experimental_demonstration.abstract_quote: chromVAR enables accurate clustering of scATAC-seq profiles and characterization of known and de novo sequence motifs associated with variation in chromatin accessibility.
experimental_demonstration.rationale: The reported capabilities concern computational clustering and motif analysis. They do not establish experimental demonstration of a physical assay contribution.

papers.rationale: A primary computational-methods contribution; the abstract describes software development without a physical assay contribution.

sequence_based_measurement.abstract_quote: Relating transcription factor (TF) expression to the genome-wide accessibility of their binding motifs classifies them as predominantly openers or closers of local chromatin accessibility, pinpointing specific cis-regulatory elements where binding of given TFs is likely functionally relevant, validated by chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing (ChIP-seq).
sequence_based_measurement.rationale: ChIP-seq validation explicitly establishes use of a physical sequencing-based measurement. The abstract does not specify preparation methods for the principal matched epigenome and transcriptome measurements.

assay_workflow_contribution.abstract_quote: We generated matched epigenome and transcriptome measurements in 86 primary cell types that span the mouse immune system and its differentiation cascades.
assay_workflow_contribution.rationale: This reports biological data generation; the subsequent contributions concern regulatory analyses. The abstract describes no new measurement architecture or experimentally evaluated assay workflow/library-preparation improvement.

experimental_demonstration.abstract_quote: We generated matched epigenome and transcriptome measurements in 86 primary cell types that span the mouse immune system and its differentiation cascades.
experimental_demonstration.rationale: Generated measurements from primary cell types establish experimental assay use. This alone does not establish an assay-level methodological contribution.

papers.rationale: The abstract supports an experimental biological application with regulatory analyses, without describing an assay workflow contribution.

sequence_based_measurement.abstract_quote: Here, we present simple and robust procedures for Tn5 transposase production and optimized reaction conditions for tagmentation-based sequencing library construction.
sequence_based_measurement.rationale: Explicitly describes physical preparation of sequencing libraries through tagmentation. The abstract does not provide complete reaction conditions.

assay_workflow_contribution.abstract_quote: We further show how molecular crowding agents both modulate library lengths and enable efficient tagmentation from subpicogram amounts of cDNA.
assay_workflow_contribution.rationale: Crowding-dependent library-length control and subpicogram cDNA tagmentation establish experimentally supported library-preparation capabilities. The suggested custom-oligonucleotide applications are not established as tested here.

experimental_demonstration.abstract_quote: The comparison of single-cell RNA-sequencing libraries generated using produced and commercial Tn5 demonstrated equal performances in terms of gene detection and library characteristics.
experimental_demonstration.rationale: Generated single-cell RNA-seq libraries were experimentally compared. The stated result establishes parity on the reported measures; quantitative estimates and replicate counts are absent.

papers.rationale: Presents experimentally evaluated tagmentation conditions and low-input library preparation alongside Tn5 production, supporting an assay-level workflow contribution.

sequence_based_measurement.abstract_quote: scNMT-seq (single-cell nucleosome, methylation and transcription sequencing) uses a GpC methyltransferase to label open chromatin followed by bisulfite and RNA sequencing.
sequence_based_measurement.rationale: Physical chromatin labeling is explicitly followed by DNA and RNA sequencing. Full library-preparation details are not supplied.

assay_workflow_contribution.abstract_quote: Here, we report a single-cell method for parallel chromatin accessibility, DNA methylation and transcriptome profiling.
assay_workflow_contribution.rationale: Introduces a joint three-modality single-cell measurement method, establishing an assay architecture contribution. The abstract does not detail physical handling of the different analytes.

experimental_demonstration.abstract_quote: We validate scNMT-seq by applying it to differentiating mouse embryonic stem cells, finding links between all three molecular layers and revealing dynamic coupling between epigenomic layers during differentiation.
experimental_demonstration.rationale: Explicit validation in differentiating mouse embryonic stem cells establishes experimental execution. Sensitivity and modality-specific accuracy are not quantified in the abstract.

papers.rationale: Introduces and experimentally validates joint single-cell accessibility, methylation and transcriptome sequencing.
